title: Social and ads
slide_intent: Teach designers to keep a message specific as its format changes. Someone scrolling a feed or glancing at a narrow banner should be able to identify the claim and its evidence.
strategic_value: Halfkey can carry a recognizable relationship between a key, its value and a proof line from a teaser to a receipt or a paid placement.
demonstration: Social examples use a pale field for the teaser, blue for launch and ink for a shared receipt. Display examples reorganize a dot figure, a short line and an action to fit tall, rectangular and horizontal units.
practical_value: A designer can choose the message, background and arrangement for a given placement using the format captions and the one-key-per-ad rule.

content_islands.name: Running header
content_islands.spec: Set Halfkey and Brand book at upper left, Social and ads and 17 at upper right.

content_islands.name: Social formats
content_islands.spec: Place a 1080 × 1350 teaser, a 1080 × 1350 launch post and a 1080 × 1920 receipt story in a row under Social. Pair the teaser instruction with its dot key, the launch announcement with the split mark, and the story with the transaction ticket.

content_islands.name: Display formats
content_islands.spec: Place a 160 × 600 tower beside a 300 × 250 rectangle under Display. Use blue grounds and show how the figure, proof line and Get Halfkey action change position to fit.

content_islands.name: Format rules
content_islands.spec: Place the One key per ad and Blue means go notes beneath the rectangle. State the jobs of the blue launch, pale teaser and dark receipt fields.

content_islands.name: Horizontal placements
content_islands.spec: Place a captioned 1500 × 500 X header and a 728 × 90 banner along the lower edge. Put the weekday dot series on the header and the Ask figure, line and action in the banner.

content_islands.name: Audience note
content_islands.spec: Place the retargeting note beside the horizontal examples. State whom the campaign addresses and the limits of its claims.
